description: This file defines extension methods for guard clauses, specifically related to basket operations in the eShopOnWeb application, such as ensuring the basket is not empty during checkout.

classes.name: BasketGuards
classes.description: A static class containing guard clause extension methods related to basket validation during checkout.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckout
methods.description: An extension method that checks if the basket has any items; if not, throws an EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException.
